title: Urate–albumin coupling does not establish incremental log-CRP prediction across NHANES recruitment datasets
abstract: A serum-urate × albumin product did not establish incremental contemporaneous log-CRP prediction beyond flexible conventional predictors in exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transfer (5,187 source;4,674 target adults): weighted MSE difference -0.000475 log(mg/L)², jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.006631,0.007346].
